stations.instrument: Apostolic constitution Si quid est in rebus humanis
stations.title: Urban VIII issues the further emended Missal

cited.basis:
The office that follows the Mass changes from Vespers to Lauds. The pre-1955
witnesses sing it `pro Vesperis in Choro` with Ps. 116 (missale-romanum-1920
41415-41446); the 1962 witness sings it `pro LAUDIBUS dominicae Resurrectionis`
with Ps. 150 (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 43393-43396, 43420). The antiphon's own
words were not read in the 1962 witness and are carried forward unchanged, which
is a weaker claim than the slot change and is why the two are separate rows.

stations.title: Maxima redemptionis restores the order of Holy Week
